plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Natural Science BS Pre-Dental Hygiene (2026-2027 Catalog) PDF, Version 2024/10/7 (version stamp predates the catalog year; this is the document linked from the 2026-2027 Degree Plans index). Header states the plan is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. ENGL 10103 and ENGL 10203 require a grade of C or better; ENGL 10203 lists PR: ENG 1463, coded as plan-level external_prereqs (excluded from credit sums per standing rules). Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 15+16+14+14+17+14+17+14 = 121; every printed semester TOTAL reconciles with its course rows. Graduation requirement: 'At least 120 Total Hours Earned'. 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed code with the full option list. ELECTIVE placeholders use code 'ELECTIVE' because the catalog names only the slot, not a course. Lecture+lab course pairs print as combined codes (e.g. BIOL 10103/BIOL 10031).
